environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; fuzzy, tactile 'bee-fuzz' texture; large, friendly dark eyes; golden-yellow pollen visible on the legs.

visual_logic.composition: A wide-angle 'bee-perspective' flying toward a bright, pale-yellow Cretaceous flower. The environment is vibrant and sunny. The purple mudstone of the Anacleto is visible as a soft-focus background, providing a beautiful color contrast.
visual_logic.ground: Sun-dappled floodplain soil with patches of early flowering ground cover.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, bright daylight that emphasizes the 'fluffiness' of the bee and the delicate petals of the flower.
